description: Knowledge about companies, markets, entrepreneurship, finance, and business operations.

topics.name: Business Fundamentals
knowledge: A business creates value by providing products or services to customers.
Businesses usually focus on revenue, costs, profit, growth, and customer satisfaction.
A company needs strategy, operations, marketing, and financial management.

topics.name: Entrepreneurship
knowledge: Entrepreneurship involves creating and developing new business ideas.
Entrepreneurs identify problems, create solutions, and build organizations.
Successful businesses require planning, innovation, and adaptation.

topics.name: Marketing
knowledge: Marketing connects businesses with customers.
Branding builds recognition and trust.
Digital marketing uses online platforms to reach audiences.
Customer research helps businesses understand demand.

topics.name: Finance
knowledge: Finance manages money, investments, expenses, and profits.
Revenue is money earned from sales.
Costs are resources spent to operate a business.
Profit is revenue remaining after expenses.

topics.name: Business Strategy
knowledge: Strategy defines how a company achieves its goals.
Competitive advantage helps a business stand out from competitors.
Businesses analyze markets, customers, and competitors before making decisions.

topics.name: E-commerce
knowledge: E-commerce allows businesses to sell products and services online.
Online stores require product management, payments, security, and customer support.
Successful e-commerce depends on trust, user experience, and reliable delivery.
